map.建立巡检路线与检查点，按周期自动排程，记录完成情况并统计完成率与问题数。: Build inspection routes and checkpoints, schedule them automatically by cycle, record completion and compute the completion rate and issue count.
map.📖 查看「巡检路线与周期计划 使用指南」: 📖 Read the "Inspection Routes and Cycle Planning" guide
map.下次巡检日 = 上次巡检日 + 周期；超过到期日未完成即计为漏检: Next inspection day = last inspection day + cycle; anything not completed by the due date counts as a missed inspection
map.巡检执行时逐个检查点标记 正常/异常 并填写备注，异常项自动计入问题数: During execution, mark each checkpoint as normal or abnormal with a note; abnormal items are counted automatically
map.完成率 = 按期完成次数 ÷ 应巡检次数；用于物业服务质量考核: Completion rate = on-time completions ÷ required inspections; used for property service quality assessment
map.📚 深度解析：巡检路线与周期计划: 📚 Deep dive: inspection routes and cycle planning
map.物业工程或安保按路线规划每日巡检点与频次: Property engineering or security plans daily inspection points and frequencies by route
map.系统算下次到期日并提醒，防漏检: The system computes the next due date and sends reminders to prevent missed inspections
map.节假日加密重点区域（配电、消防）巡检: Increase inspection frequency in key areas (power distribution, fire protection) around holidays
map.某路线频次 7 天、上次巡检 2026-03-10 → 下次到期 2026-03: A route with a 7-day frequency last inspected on 2026-03-10 → next due 2026-03-17; if today is 03-19 it is 2 days overdue, flagged in red for re-inspection.
map.A 路线含配电房 + 水泵房 + 消防栓（每日）、B 路线含楼道 + 车库（每: Route A covers the distribution room + pump room + fire hydrants (daily), route B covers corridors + car park (every 3 days) → resourcing: 1 person per day for A, rotating duty for B.
map.巡检周期怎么定？: How should the inspection cycle be set?
map.按风险：配电、消防每日，一般公区每周；法规或合同有要求的从其规定。: Base it on risk: distribution and fire protection daily, general common areas weekly; follow the rules where regulations or the contract specify them.
map.漏检了怎么补？: What if an inspection is missed?
map.系统标红逾期项，主管安排补检并登记原因，避免因漏检导致设备隐患扩大。: The system flags overdue items in red and the supervisor arranges a re-inspection and records the reason, preventing equipment hazards from escalating.
map.面向物业与设施管理的巡检排程工具，建立巡检路线与检查点，按周期自动排程并记录完成: An inspection scheduling tool for property and facility management that builds inspection routes and checkpoints, schedules them automatically by cycle, records completion, and computes the completion rate and issue count.
